collection.title: VW Amarok 2010 to 2012 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A VW Amarok Pick-Up 2010 to 2012 model requires a 24" wiper blade for the drivers and a 21" blade for the passengers side with a Standard Hook arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. We also have the option to upgrade to the Retrofit style blade. Please Note - The Passenger blade listed is slightly shorter than the original.
